[LCRS.17.2] **`as` binds; nothing continues.** A call to a `no response`
service may bind `as` ([LCRS.3.1]), so that its `CallError` carries the
correlation. It may not open a response continuation ([LCCO.2]): nothing comes
back to continue on. The compiler must reject one
(`DS_VALIDATE_NO_RESPONSE_CONTINUATION`).

Nor may it open a `timeout` continuation. With nothing ever coming back, the
timeout would fire on every call that does not fail; an `error` continuation
already covers failure, and `after` covers a delay. The compiler must reject
one (`DS_VALIDATE_NO_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT`).
